pages.label: Reply tray
pages.help: Choose the tray view, where it shows, card text and where the scene header lives.

corrections.label: ◇ How it ran · Runs in code

portrayal.label: Pronouns for Seraphina (the character)
portrayal.help: Versions use these wherever they have a pronoun label, so one instruction set works with any character.

portrayal.label: Pronouns for User (you)
portrayal.help: Versions use these wherever they have a pronoun label, so one instruction set works with any character.

stat-sheets.label: Stats in use
stat-sheets.help: Separate them with commas. Each sheet gives every stat a modifier from -20 to +20.

voices.label: Check each line by transcription
voices.help: The desktop transcribes each line and renders it again with a new seed when the words differ. Names are listed in the receipt for your ear.

voices.label: More feeling on exclaimed and shouted lines
voices.help: Off by default. A line with an exclamation or a word in capitals, or a quote the narration says was shouted, yelled or snapped, gets a little more expressiveness for that line only. Decided here in code; the receipt names each lift.

books.label: World Info books for this chat
Base World
books.help: Choose an existing World Info book or upload a native JSON export. The pinned copy keeps its triggers.

books.label: Role for books you add
books.help: Guidelines supply writing directions. Reference books hold facts about people, places, or anything else.

books.label: Name
books.help: The new book uses the selected role. Add entries from the new book’s card.

books-memory.label: Story may add to this book
Receive story events
books-memory.help: One behavior book per chat takes the story events chapters suggest. Each one waits on the review list in Setup, Memory first.

books-memory.label: What the entries should do
books-memory.help: For example: "rival smugglers turn up at the docks now and then".

sets.label: Story event item writer: system message

story-rules.label: Kept with
story-rules.help: Rules kept with a story event set work in every chat where that set is on.

set-rules.label: How many new things can start in one reply
set-rules.help: Counted across every instruction set, story event set, the goal and the world orders. When more are ready, one is picked at random; 0 turns this off.How it worksThe others wait for a later reply. Something already under way (kept for more replies, or sent again because it did not happen) uses up the room first. Writing style and the goal line are always sent.

set-rules.label: New sets are kept in
set-rules.help: Every set you add from now on gets a World Info book of its own, named after the set.
set-rules.value: A World Info book of its own for each set

set-rules.label: Calm after a big event (replies)
set-rules.help: After a big event, nothing new starts for this many replies across every set, the goal and the story world. 0 turns this off.How it worksBig events are story event sets marked "Events from this set are big" and an open thread of the story world coming to a head. What is already under way carries on.

set-rules.label: Order a character who has gone silent (replies)
set-rules.help: Needs a story world. A character who has been in the scene for this many replies without being named in the story text is ordered to speak or act; 0 turns this off.How it worksThe order counts as the one new thing of that reply and is checked.

set-rules.label: Story phases
set-rules.help: Off: every chance stays as you set it for the whole chat.

set-rules.label: Move the story clock
set-rules.help: A line in your message that starts "Time skip:" followed by an amount such as "three days" moves the story clock forward before the reply is written. If the amount cannot be read, the clock is marked unknown until the reply is filed.

set-rules.label: Close the chapter
set-rules.help: A "Time skip:" line, a "Scene:" line or a line of *** closes the open chapter at the newest reply, so your message starts a new one. The chapter is written the same way "Close the chapter here" writes it.

set-rules.label: List Pending events that fell due
set-rules.help: After a "Time skip:", Pending events whose due time falls inside the skipped time are listed, and the next filing of the story rules on each.

set-rules.label: Check each reply that was sent an instruction
set-rules.help: Automatic checks also need the permission below. Each check uses one additional model call to look for evidence in the reply.

set-rules.label: While one is waiting to be sent again, hold back new instructions
set-rules.help: On: the overdue instruction goes alone, so the AI has one thing to do.

set-rules.label: Regenerate when an instruction did not happen
set-rules.help: When automatic replacement is permitted, SillyTavern makes one additional swipe request after a missed instruction.

set-rules.label: Check that the reply did not write for you
set-rules.help: Checked in the same request, only on replies that were sent an instruction.
set-rules.value: Show a warning in What was sent

set-rules.label: An open thread builds by itself after (replies)
set-rules.help: A thread that has not moved for this many replies goes up one step, as far as "About to come to a head". 0 leaves the steps to the story and to you.

set-rules.label: Chance that something ready is ordered into the scene (%)
set-rules.help: Each reply has this chance that one thing below becomes an order for it. 0 turns this off.How it worksThe order counts as the one new thing per reply and is checked like any instruction.

set-rules.label: Replies before a planted detail or a thing going on elsewhere can be ordered in
set-rules.help: So that something new has time to sit before it matters.

set-rules.label: An open thread that is about to come to a head
set-rules.help: The order: it comes to a head in this reply. When it happens the thread is marked "Happening now".

set-rules.label: A planted detail
set-rules.help: The order: the detail matters in this reply. When it happens it is marked "Paid off".

set-rules.label: Something going on elsewhere
set-rules.help: The order: it reaches the scene in this reply. When it happens it is marked "Finished".

set-rules.label: A kept secret of someone in the scene
set-rules.help: The order: the secret comes out in this reply and is marked "Out in the open". Off to start with, so secrets come out only when you or the story decide.

goals.label: One-time steps (each happens once, in any order)
What the character is working toward
goals.help: One plain sentence. Keep it loose, for example: {{char}} wants {{user}} to trust {{char.them}}.

goals.label: Chance to add a task each reply (%)
goals.help: At most one task is sent at a time. 35 adds a task to about 1 reply in 3.

goals.label: A repeatable action waits at least (replies)
goals.help: After it is sent, it is left alone for a number of replies between these two.

goals.label: A repeatable action waits at most (replies)
The goal is done when every one-time step is done
goals.help: Off: the goal stays in progress until you press "Mark the goal done".

goals.label: When the goal is done
goals.help: The next goal is the one after this one in your list.

goals.label: Turn the goal on or off for this chat

story-outline.label: Story outline
story-outline.help: Off stops the runs and takes the outline out of the Director's desk. The text stays on file.

story-outline.label: Possible next chapters
story-outline.help: One chapter per line. Your edit stays as you wrote it; the writer reads it at the next reply.

story-outline.label: When you have edited it, the next run
story-outline.help: "Write the outline now" always rewrites from your text.

writing.label: Portrayal intensity
writing.help: Choose the shared guidance used in this chat. Existing character material still has priority.

writing.label: Show turn length and dialogue share
writing.help: Add word count and the approximate percentage in quotation marks to the reply’s Notes tab.

writing.label: Review recent writing with the reply
writing.help: Add a short review of recurring writing patterns when at least two earlier story replies are available. Notes show which revisions support each finding.

writing.label: Social realism and character fidelity check

inline-notes.label: Notes in [[OOC: ]]
inline-notes.help: Off leaves the brackets in your message like any other text.

inline-notes.label: [[OOC: ]]
inline-notes.help: Wraps the selection in [[OOC: ]]. The note is cut from your message and sent once, privately.

presets.label: Document view of the working copy

preset-cleanup.label: Copies of a base (0 of 14 ready)

memory.label: Books Recall manages
memory.help: None yet. Switch a book on in Story, World Info.

memory.label: World Info recall
memory.help: Include the pinned Base World and relevant Story World entries. World Info remains under SillyTavern control.

memory.label: Chapter summaries
memory.help: Write and recall chapter summaries. Each new chapter uses one model call.

memory.label: Exclude summarized messages from prompts
memory.help: Enable Chapter summaries first. Only saved chapters can hide messages.

memory.label: Where the notes are placed
memory.help: In the chat, above your last message. Works with every preset, and a chat whose memory lives in chat data sends Recall instead.
memory.value: In the chat, above your last message

memory.label: How many messages up
memory.help: 0 is the very end of the chat, 1 is above your last message. A deeper place costs the prompt cache more messages each turn.

memory.label: Messages read for names
memory.help: When the reply has no scene header or HUD, people named in this many recent messages count as present. Other entries named there are added while room is left.

memory.label: Protect recent history by
memory.help: Choose how to size the full-text window for covered history. The opening and unsummarized messages stay available.

memory.label: Recent messages to protect
memory.help: Protects this many recent story messages.

memory.label: Chat model size
memory.help: Auto reads the context size SillyTavern is set to. The size sets the caps below.

memory.label: Room for Recall (tokens)
memory.help: Estimated budget for the scene, explicit activations and relevant story entries. Chapters have a separate budget.

memory.label: Chapter notes budget
memory.help: Approximate text budget for the story so far.

memory.label: Current state prompt budget
memory.help: Approximate room for scene and character state; lines that do not fit are left out.

memory.label: Capture
memory.help: Every five replies is offered while the state cards are off, since nothing then needs the newest values at once.

memory.label: Keep the world up to date from each reply
memory.help: With each reply the AI adds a short block recording what the reply made true, and the extension files it here with no extra model call. Entries you wrote are only touched on the changing lines.How it worksThe extension takes the block out of the reply. New people, places, groups, threads, secrets and planted details are added, and what people want, plan and know is kept current.

memory.label: A branch gets its own copy of the world
memory.help: On: the first time a branch is opened, it gets its own World Info book, so changes there never touch the chat it came from.How it worksThe book is named after the story world with "(branch)". Recorded later changes are rewound on the copy, and swipes and deletes in the branch undo changes in the copy only.

memory.label: Earlier replies kept editable
memory.help: Automatic Story World changes file as soon as a reply is accepted.

memory.label: Move finished records into chapters
memory.help: Keeps completed threads and events with the chapter that covers them.

memory.label: Recent chapters eligible for full recall
memory.help: The chapter budget also limits recall.

memory.label: Combine older chapters when there are more than
memory.help: Combining follows the saved automatic request setting.

memory.label: Write a chapter when the scene ends
memory.help: Requires Story World updates and at least the minimum number of replies.

memory.label: Minimum replies for a scene-end chapter
memory.help: A reply is a model message.

memory.label: Write a chapter at least every
memory.help: Set 0 to disable the reply-count threshold.

memory.label: Summarize at estimated tokens
memory.help: After an accepted reply, a chapter is written when unsummarized text reaches this estimate. Set 0 to turn the token threshold off.

memory.label: World Info recall for this chat
Catch up by itself on free routes

settings.label: Compare preset blocks and extension features
What the AI writes for you
Automatic requests
settings.help: When a filed reply qualifies at an enabled reply count, scene-end or token threshold. Budget is one request per trigger.

settings.label: Give the AI more room to answer
settings.help: Increase the answer budget for models that use part of the answer for reasoning. An empty answer leaves the next attempt up to you.

settings.label: Rules given to the AI writer
settings.help: One rule per line, in plain words. They are added to every writing request.

settings.label: Flag words from your list
settings.help: On: 57 words are on the list. Text that uses one gets the line "On your word list" where you review it, and you can always keep the text.

settings.label: Your word list
settings.help: This list runs locally. Separate words with commas; a star at the end matches any ending, and capitals make no difference.

display.label: Show what was sent under each reply
Show arriving story sections
display.help: Preview the reply cards as their fields arrive. Turn off for a single progress line.

display.label: Show Reply planning
display.help: Show any emitted outline in a collapsed disclosure.

display.label: World Info under replies
display.help: Show a collapsed card with the selected entries and their source books. This controls visibility only.

display.label: Show Roast cards
display.help: Show the saved Roast beneath its reply. Choose the commentator voice below.

display.label: Keep exact story guidance
display.help: Save confirmed extension guidance for inspection in What was sent.

display.label: Under each reply
display.help: Nothing is added to the chat screen. What was sent is always in Review, Context, What was sent.

help.label: Add a route
help.help: A route joins the end of the list. Each saved Connection Profile is listed by its name.

cards.label: Scene
cards.effect: Where and when the reply happens, who is present and what can be seen.

cards.label: Map
cards.effect: The current room as a text grid with who and what stands where.

cards.label: Characters
cards.effect: What each present character is doing, thinking and feeling, and who they are.

cards.label: Emotions
cards.effect: How strongly each character feels, with the change since the last reply.

cards.label: Relationships
cards.effect: Each pair, how far along they are and what moved it.

cards.label: Holding back
cards.effect: What a character lets themselves show or say to another, and the strain.

cards.label: Knowledge and secrets
cards.effect: Who knows what, secrets with their owners, false beliefs and what each person remembers.

cards.label: Inventory
cards.effect: Items per character with what changed and why it counts.

cards.label: Plot
cards.effect: Open threads, story lines, what happens elsewhere and what is waiting to pay off.

cards.label: New faces
cards.effect: A profile sheet where a named character first appears.

cards.label: Reputation
cards.effect: How each group or source sees you, which way it is moving and why.

cards.label: Achievements
cards.effect: A title, how rare it is and what earned it.

cards.label: Story changes
cards.effect: What this reply filed into the story and which threads it closed.

cards.label: World Info
cards.effect: The World Info entries used for this reply, each linking to its entry.

cards.label: Director's desk
cards.effect: The reply plan and where the next beat heads.

cards.label: Choices
cards.effect: Numbered moves for your next message, each with Copy, Insert and Send.

cards.label: Stats
cards.effect: This chat's stat sheets with level and growth notes.

cards.label: Roll
cards.effect: One line per roll in this reply.

cards.label: Notebook
cards.effect: Narrator notes and private diary entries.

cards.label: Roast
cards.effect: A reader commenting on the reply, in one voice or as a panel.

cards.label: Sent
cards.effect: What went with this reply, which connection answered and what each background call cost.

cards.label: Notes
cards.effect: Reply screening notes and problems found in this reply.
